result.note: Tests the WTO sugarcane subsidy challenge by Australia: the alleged support level against the threshold, and the Appellate Body's status.

questions.prompt: In September 2026, Australia asked India to defend its sugarcane subsidies at the World Trade Organization (WTO). Consider the following statements:
items: Australia alleged that India's support for sugarcane amounts to about 10% of the crop's value.
The WTO's Appellate Body is functioning, which limits India's ability to stall the challenge.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: Australia alleged support worth 90 to 95% of crop value; 10% is the threshold, not the alleged level. The Appellate Body is non-functional, which is why India can stall the challenge.
questions.source: alleging support worth 90 to 95% of crop value against a 10% threshold, a challenge India can stall through the WTO's non-functional Appellate Body.
